tolerance_policy: No engineering near-reproduction pass threshold. Exact equality of deterministic outputs is tested. Stored-metric consistency uses original verifier 1e-7 rounding rule only. Paper display rounding uses the unchanged original verifier.
prompt_boundary: Exact recorded config, system prompt and runner invocation checked. Tokenizer chat-template/prompt byte strings were not logged. Action-state prefixes are compared until trajectories diverge; later prompts legitimately differ.
interpretation: The complete checkpoint workflow ran successfully and all collected contracts/metrics verified, but regenerated predictions and displayed paper numbers were not identical. Do not advertise full exact re-inference or from-scratch replication.
limitations: Existing environment, current hardware; no fresh training or environment installation.
Speech policy was rerun on frozen frontend, not TTS/Seamless regeneration.
Wall-clock/compute-aware timing is measured separately and is not expected identical.
Full scientific-protocol caveats remain in docs/VERIFICATION.md.
The cause of numeric drift has not been isolated; a hardware/precision/environment difference is a plausible explanation, not proven causation.
No manuscript or original experimental result was changed.
